# LinguaReel 闁?AI video translator

> LinguaReel is an AI video translator that turns a video into another language. One upload produces translated SRT subtitles, a dubbed MP3 and a subtitled MP4 in 12+ languages, all rendered from the same transcript so the subtitle and the dub never disagree. Free 60-second trial with no sign-up; per-minute pricing quoted after upload and before payment.

## Facts

- URL: https://linguareel.xyz
- Outputs: SRT subtitles, MP3 dub, subtitled MP4 (one transcript, three deliverables)
- Inputs: MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WEBM, plus audio-only files
- Languages: 12+ target languages, chosen after upload
- Free trial: up to 60 seconds and 100 MB, subtitles only, no account, limited per network
- Pricing: per minute, quoted after upload and before payment; quotes valid 30 minutes
- Paid status: paid plans are rolling out; the trial is live
- Not offered: lip-sync re-animation, voice cloning
- Rights: uploader keeps all rights and must own the rights to translate the video
- Operator: Yiwu Zexu E-commerce Co., Ltd.
- Support: support@linguareel.xyz

## Common questions

- Is it free? A 60-second, 100 MB trial with subtitles only, no account required.
- Does it dub? Yes, MP3 output in the target language.
- Does it do lip-sync? No.
- Does it work on audio-only files? Yes.
- Who owns the video? The uploader; LinguaReel receives a limited licence to process and return it.
